title: Supplier choice
passage: Would you rather order locally or from our usual supplier? A. Let us compare their delivery dates first. B. The order number is printed here. C. Yes, it was delivered locally.
passageZh:
你想向本地廠商訂購，還是向我們慣用的供應商訂購？
A. 我們先比較他們的交貨日期吧。
B. 訂單編號印在這裡。
C. 是的，它在本地送達。
audioScript: Would you rather order locally or from our usual supplier? A. Let us compare their delivery dates first. B. The order number is printed here. C. Yes, it was delivered locally.
